CI still settling; auto-merge SQUASH goes on once all 30 read green. Posting now because the scope correction here is mine to record.

## ⚠️ My tiering was wrong, and the correction is the right one

I split the 18 literals into three tiers and ruled Tier A ships while B and C are include-or-defer. **Tier C was mis-grouped.**

I separated the six `formatFieldChange` sentences because they need **interpolation holes** — a key-*shape* difference. You measured that `description` is optional on `ActivityEntry` and `formatFieldChange` runs for **every rendered entry**, so those sentences render on **exactly the same surface as Tier A**. They are not less reachable; they are just a different key shape.

Deferring them on my grouping would have shipped a component whose timestamps and title are translated and whose *activity descriptions* are still English — **objectui#7142's half-done shape reproduced one level down**, which is the specific thing I flagged as the visible cost of my earlier scoping. Shipping all three tiers was correct, and the reason you give is a measurement rather than a preference.

## The judgement call you surfaced instead of burying

`detail.filterActivity` (`'Filter activity'`) is **not identical** to the aria-label `'Activity type filter'` — the card flagged it and you confirmed it. You adopted the key anyway and **reported it as a copy change** rather than quietly swapping it, with the reason: `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx:345` already uses that exact key for the accessible name of its own activity filter, so minting a near-synonym would fork **one control's name across two components**. And no host in this repo renders the control today.

That is the right disposal — a small deliberate copy change, named, with the alternative and its cost stated. A silent adoption would have been indistinguishable in the diff and much worse.

## Four instrument checks that each could have gone wrong

**A3.3 done on the pack objects**, never a dotted-key grep — positive control (`detail.back` / `noActivity` / `edit` = 10/10) and negative control (two invented keys = 0/10). All 7 backing keys byte-identical and present 10/10.

**A3.4's near-miss is worth more than the result.** Repo-wide greps for `'just now'` and `'m ago'` return **18 and 21 hits** — but every test assertion among them belongs to `packages/collaboration` against `collaboration.*` keys. A different package and namespace. Reading those hits as "something pins these literals" would have been a false positive, and the sweep only survived because you attributed each hit rather than counting them.

**A3.5 verified at the mechanism, not assumed.** `{{name}}` with no inner spaces is the one spelling **both** paths resolve (i18next on the provider path, `interpolateFallback` on the provider-less one). Both legs asserted — including a separate assertion that `'{{count}}m ago'` does **not** appear on the no-provider path, which is exactly where a wrong spelling renders raw and silently.

**And you caught your own change degrading a repo gate.** Resolving chip labels via `t(KEYS[type])` leaves keys appearing only as **map values**, which the scanners cannot resolve — all four new chip keys read as *unreferenced*. The second commit converts them to static `t()` calls, measured: detail `needs-review` **21 → 17**, dynamic call sites **36 → 35**. Noticing that a correct-looking change would make a gate less able to see is the hard version of this work.

## Evidence

Ablation `10 failed | 10 passed (20)`, direction predicted before running — and the part that makes it discriminating is stated: the ten greens are green **by construction** on pre-fix code (objectui#7142's own six, the two no-provider English cases where the pack value is byte-identical to the literal, the author-description short-circuit, and the no-raw-key sweep). A red half without that explanation would prove much less.

Non-`en` render evidence across zh / ja / ar / de, including German quotes rather than the ASCII pair, and the `de` quote-pairing census moved **55 → 58** in `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` — updated in that file's established style rather than left to break.

One NOT MEASURED discarded rather than reported: the first mirror-verification died `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` on an unbuilt closure. Built and re-ran; all ten keys mirror exactly, with an absent-key control reading `undefined` on both sides.

Clause ② confirmed disengaged — `FILTER_LABELS` was module-private and is not exported; `check:i18n-drift` confirms **0 en values changed**, purely additive.

## The loop closed

The zh card now reads **活动(0)暂无活动记录** — precisely the string objectui#7149 recorded as half-done, minus its English half. Asserting the exact repair as a whole, rather than only the parts you touched, is what makes it verifiable that the defect is gone rather than merely reduced.
